Subject: Reminder regarding workplace conduct

Dear [Employee Name],

I am writing to address some recent concerns regarding your behavior in the workplace. We have received multiple complaints indicating that your conduct has not aligned with our company’s values.

It is important that we maintain a professional and respectful environment for everyone. We expect an immediate improvement in your behavior and full adherence to our professional standards moving forward.

Please let me know if you would like to discuss this further or if there are any underlying issues we can help resolve.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
